Title: Submit User Details form with valid name and phone number
Preconditions: App is running (streamlit run ui/app.py) and sidebar shows Home, Contact Us, User Details
Steps: 1. Launch the app | 2. Click 'User Details' in the sidebar | 3. Enter a valid name | 4. Enter a valid phone number | 5. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Form clears, a success message 'Thank you, John Smith! Your details have been submitted.' is shown, and a table listing the submitted user appears below the form

Title: Navigate from Contact Us to User Details and submit
Preconditions: App is running with default Home page loaded
Steps: 1. Launch the app (Home page loads by default) | 2. Click 'Contact Us' in the sidebar and verify email/phone support info is shown | 3. Click 'User Details' in the sidebar (page listed directly after Contact Us) | 4. Enter name and phone number | 5. Click 'Submit' | 6. Confirm the entry appears in the 'Submitted Users' table
Expected Result: User successfully moves Home -> Contact Us -> User Details, the User Details page renders after Contact Us in the sidebar order, and the submitted entry (Priya Rao, 9876543210) is visible in the results table

Title: Submit phone number at minimum allowed length boundary (7 digits)
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a 7-digit phone number | 3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Submission succeeds since 7 digits is the minimum accepted length; success message and table entry are shown

Title: Submit phone number exceeding maximum allowed length (16 digits)
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a 16-digit phone number | 3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Form displays error 'Phone number must contain 7-15 digits (an optional leading '+' is allowed).' and no entry is added to the table

Title: Submit phone number with leading plus sign (international format)
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a phone number with a leading '+' and 11 digits | 3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Submission succeeds, success message is shown, and the entry appears in the Submitted Users table with the '+' preserved

Title: Submit form with empty name field
Steps: 1. Leave the name field blank | 2. Enter a valid phone number | 3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Form displays error 'Name is required.' and no entry is added to the Submitted Users table

Title: Submit form with non-numeric phone number
Steps: 1. Enter a valid name | 2. Enter a phone number containing letters | 3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Form displays error 'Phone number must contain 7-15 digits (an optional leading '+' is allowed).' and no entry is added to the table
